segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Use compression and high quality options to export optimized resources. let cube = try TextureResource( cubeFromEquirectangular: image, quality: .high, options: TextureResource.CreateOptions(semantic: .color) ) let options = EnvironmentResource.CreateOptions( samplingQuality: .high, specularCubeDimension: cube.width/2, compression: .astc(blockSize: .block4x4, quality: .high) ) let environment = try EnvironmentResource( cube: cube, options: EnvironmentResource.CreateOptions( samplingQuality: .high, specularCubeDimension: cube.width/2, compression: .astc(blockSize: .block4x4, quality: .high) ) ) let lightEntity = Entity() lightEntity.components.set(ImageBasedLightComponent( source: .single(environment) )) ... ```
